card.title: Order of Business
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the kitchen fire, may I approve last week's minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The minutes are in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must establish whether anyone remembers them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember voting to replace the extinguisher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can begin with matters arising.

mechanism: A insists on approving minutes before handling the fire and turns the extinguisher memory into the next sanctioned agenda category.
confusable: Unlike uncertainty about authority, A assumes control of order and absorbs urgent information into the existing sequence.
comparison: The fire alternative converts rescue-relevant information into matters arising; the wedding alternative accelerates required introductions without abandoning their order.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
